_comment: NEUTRAL DEFAULT — served for unknown subdomains and unknown hosts. Contains NO Troy branding, NO Troy phone numbers, NO HighLevel location, NO calendar — a stranger's subdomain gets a blank-slate brand and no CRM data (cc-data.js answers those requests with an honest error instead of Troy's feed). Copy _template.json to {subdomain}.json to onboard a real client; NEVER put API tokens or secrets here — they live in Netlify env vars only.
